column1: # Rows db.ps7b.* (line PS, PS7b): psiblast -in_pssm and -in_msa with non-default -matrix, -gapopen and -gapextend (all 8 matrices, 32767/32767, lowercase matrix names, multi-round PSSM files, all-zero ratios, ratios-only with search gap costs, all-X ratios-only error order, zero-gap fallback, and split-length CHUNK_SIZE=150). Freeze alone with `freeze --program psiblast --only db.ps7b.`.
